source_first.authorship: AI-assisted implementation and source-first tests; NOT independently human reviewed
source_first.semantics: Proc mountinfo fields ordered, optional-field separator -, four octal pathname escapes, parent IDs can point outside snapshot, anonymous optional tags opaque

behaviors: Pure mountinfo parser accepts max 1MiB, 4096 records, bounded token/line length, strict UTF8
Trusted one-to-one SRC14 D0 fixed worker /proc/self/mountinfo source-path and item0001 ordinal required
Exact operation receipt label MOUNTINFO and no target required; no host filesystem access or path traversal by parser
Private typed ARRAY record includes mount ID, parent ID, device major/minor, root, mount point, mount options, optional tags, filesystem type, source and super options
Opaque mount and super options, no unsupported filesystem-health, writeability, capacity or medium identity inference
Malformed record -> attributed parser error with preserved unmodified original, CAPTURE_LIMIT priority kept
No original raw-source pointer introduced into public outputs
limitations: G5-02 source bound is 16MiB while conservative semantic parser bound is 1MiB; larger valid captures remain sealed originals but cannot yield semantic COMPLETE
SRC-14 provides mount topology reported by kernel, not used/free space or proof of USB/internal/network physical attachment
Parent ID may legitimately be outside current mount namespace view
